context: Diff the PR 6 ADR and skill changes against current main, retain only evidence-backed selection guidance, and avoid any runtime or schema changes. Decision gate: stop if the policy requires a capability not present in current Herdr or native agent runtimes, changes default execution behavior, or introduces untested user-facing CLI vocabulary.
description: Publish the executor-selection ADR and matching documentation as a separate policy-only change because it is tangential to registry, team, cleanup, and review mechanics. Reconcile the proposed ADR 0005 text against current runtime capabilities and naming policy before carrying it forward from PR 6.

anti_patterns.dont: Bundle executor policy with team runtime implementation
anti_patterns.instead: Publish it as a documentation-only PR
anti_patterns.why: It is independently reviewable and does not share the runtime dependency chain

anti_patterns.dont: Copy PR 6 ADR text without revalidation
anti_patterns.instead: Recheck each capability claim against current authoritative state
anti_patterns.why: Runtime and model capabilities can drift

anti_patterns.dont: Introduce aspirational runtime behavior through normative documentation
anti_patterns.instead: Describe only current behavior and explicitly label deferred decisions
anti_patterns.why: Required behavior must exist in deterministic code or an approved roadmap

preserves.behavior: Executor guidance remains capability-based rather than model-brand-based where possible.
No current agent or external worker capability is asserted without live or repository evidence.
One canonical vocabulary is used across ADR, workflow, README, and skill.
This TODO changes no runtime behavior, schema, CLI command, or test contract.
